metaTitle: Custom Rainbow Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rainbow badge ID holders for your team. Perfect for Pride events and inclusive workplaces. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rainbow badge ID holders add a vibrant, inclusive touch to any workplace or event. Whether you're celebrating Pride Month, promoting diversity and inclusion, or simply want to add color to your team's uniforms, these holders make a statement. Durable clear vinyl with a rainbow print keeps IDs visible while showcasing your organization's values. Choose from horizontal or vertical styles, and add your logo for a fully customized look that stands out in a crowd.
heroAltText: Custom rainbow badge ID holders with clear vinyl and colorful rainbow pattern for displaying employee IDs.
